title: atmos.yaml - minimal config for auth only
content:
auth:
  providers:
    aws-prod:
      kind: aws-sso
      type: aws
      region: us-east-1
      sso_start_url: https://mycompany.awsapps.com/start
      sso_region: us-east-1
      sso_account_id: "123456789012"
      sso_role_name: AdministratorAccess

identities:
    prod-admin:
      provider: aws-prod
      default: true
bash
